reviews.text: Nice knowledgeable staff to help you. They often have sales on certain products. Self-washing of dogs is affordable and very popular

I love going to this pet store to find dog treats/food for my cocker spaniel. The ladies who work there are very helpful, they have experience with the products and can recommend what works and why somethings don’t work. I really appreciate it. They are GREAT with my dog, especially when I go to get her nails cut, you can simply drop in, and it costs 100 kroners. Most Places around Oslo you have to schedule an appointment and wait weeks and pay 300 kroners.

Their hairdresser is amazing and my dog ​​doesn't like hairdressers but she is very enthusiastic about her. And he gets a beautiful and careful cut every time. Thank you❤️ has become our regular hairdresser and will be back soon 🤩 …

Giving 1 star because of an employee who was caught lying today. This was basically a Wolt order that your employee called me about to cancel because she said they didn't have any of the things I ordered. There were a lot of items in the order, so I can't understand why you didn't have any of those things. Note that I ordered the items a little before closing time, but there was still a little while left, and the courier had definitely arrived. Contacted Wolt support so they could investigate the matter, and they got feedback that my order was canceled due to "technical problems in the store". And there I got a response that your employee lied to get away with it. It was very frustrating when I also looked at the map inside the Wolt app that the courier was there right away, and the employee just left. Hope you can address this, and tighten up!
